act_title: Inland Revenue Amendment Act No. 45 of 2022 (English)

rows.description: The total of the Capital allowances granted and calculated under the Fourth Schedule to this Act in respect of a depreciable asset shall not exceed the cost of such depreciable asset in any circumstances.

circumstances.”.
